entities.summary: Modupe Ozolua is a Lebanese-Nigerian-American philanthropist and entrepreneur. She was the CEO of Body Enhancement Ltd and is the founding president of Empower 54 Project Initiatives formerly known as Body Enhancement Annual Reconstructive Surgery (BEARS) Foundation.
